999.o: Franky faces Big Mom with the help of Robin and Jimbei, but the Numbers come interrupting their battle. One of them holds Brachio Tank with Usopp and Chopper inside in his hand. Meanwhile, Yamato, the self-proclaimed Oden, finally meets his son Momonosuke.

1000.t: Overwhelming Strength! The Straw Hats Come Together!
1000.o: As the Minks struggle with a poor hand against the Gifters, Kin’emon tries to assist them, but Dogstorm and Cat Viper stop him and start fighting for the other Minks! Meanwhile, Luffy and Zoro try to get to the rooftop to help Kin’emon and the others, but Queen and King get in their way.

1001.t: A Risky Invitation! A Plot to Eliminate Queen!
1001.o: Who’s-Who invites Drake and Hawkins to a plot to kill Queen. Meanwhile, the Straw Hats are facing two large monsters that remind them of the Giant who they once struggled to take down. As Luffy charges towards them, someone unexpected comes in to help.

1002.t: A New Rivalry! Nami and Ulti!
1002.o: Drake vows to fight alongside Luffy, but Zoro becomes skeptical and challenges him to a fight. Meanwhile, Usopp’s practical joke pushes Nami into confronting Ulti, who is infuriated since her brother got attacked.

1003.t: A Heroic Blade! Akazaya vs. Kaido, Again Once More!
1003.o: Queen uses a new version of the Plague Bullets which will turn the samurai into ogre-like monsters. Meanwhile, the Minks keep pushing the fight against the Gifters and drive Jack into a corner. However, Kaido stands up for his subordinate.

1004.t: An Inherited Technique! Unleashing Oden’s Secret Swordplay!
1004.o: While Luffy is hurrying to the rooftop and Yamato is trying to catch up to Momonosuke to protect him, the Akazaya members finally face off against Kaido. Hearing Kaido jeering at them for being weak, the samurai retainers attack him relentlessly, remembering the day Oden told them to master his sword skill.

1005.t: The Power of Ice Oni! A New Version of the Plague Rounds!
1005.o: Queen, the Lead Performer, blazes away at samurai on the Performance Floor with the special version of the Plague Rounds, which turns them into hideous ogres that corner Zoro and Drake. Meanwhile, Luffy and Sanji, who are on their way to the rooftop, run into another Headliner with a special ability.

1006.t: I Won’t Forgive Him! Chopper’s Determination!
1006.o: King orders his subordinates to go after Momonosuke. Shinobu tries to protect him, but they are cornered by one of the strong Lead Performers from the Animal Kingdom Pirates. Meanwhile, seeing people suffering from Queen’s Plague Rounds, Chopper is determined to save everyone.

1007.o: Yamato fights Sasaki and the Animal Kingdom Pirates Armored Division to protect Momonosuke. Meanwhile, Zoro tries to get rid of the Gifters who have turned into Ice Oni, but Queen starts a horrible game which involves the antibody for the virus.

1008.o: Ulti and Page One of the Tobi Roppo chase Nami and Usopp, after being infuriated by their attack as well as Luffy’s declaration of becoming the King of the Pirates. Cornered, Nami gives in and Ulti pushes her to say the unthinkable.

1009.t: Sasaki’s Onslaught! Armored Division vs. Yamato!
1009.o: Carrot and Wanda step in to help Marco, who is cornered by Big Mom and Perospero. In the meantime, Yamato fights a fierce battle against the Animal Kingdom Pirates Armored Division led by Sasaki, while protecting Shinobu and Momonosuke.

1010.t: Eliminate the Ice Oni! Chopper’s Fire Trick!
1010.o: Zoro and Drake continue to chase Apoo to get the antibody against Ice Oni, while Chopper is trying to figure out how to fight the virus. In the castle, Luffy, Jimbei, and Sanji are climbing up the stairs to reach the rooftop where the Akazaya members’ tough battle against Kaido rages on.

1011.t: It’s Not Okay! The Spider Lures Sanji!
1011.o: Sanji hears a woman’s scream for help and dashes into the room the scream can be heard from. However, it’s a trap set up by Black Maria of the Tobi Roppo. Meanwhile, Luffy and Jimbei who are trying to reach the rooftop get help from the unexpected.

1012.t: A Turnaround Move! The Flames of Marco the Phoenix!
1012.o: While Kaido begins the New Onigashima Project, Marco appears in front of Chopper and the others, who are struggling with Ice Oni. The members of the Tobi Roppo continue to give the Straw Hats a hard time while their former member helps Zoro.

1013.t: Yamato’s Past! The Man Who Came for an Emperor of the Sea!
1013.o: Yamato tells Momonosuke and Shinobu that he once confronted a man, who came to Onigashima looking to get Kaido’s head. His name was Ace. The two of them engaged in a fierce battle that eventually turned into an important friendship.

1014.t: Marco’s Tears! The Bond of the Whitebeard Pirates!
1014.o: The formidable Lead Performers of the Animal Kingdom Pirates stand in Zoro’s way as he tries to get to the rooftop. Marco sees his late comrade in Zoro’s determination and tries to pave the way for him.

1015.t: Straw Hat Luffy! The Man Who Will Become the King of the Pirates!
1015.o: Yamato tells Momonosuke and Shinobu about how Ace gave him hope for the future. Meanwhile, Luffy and the other allied pirates from the Worst Generation make it to the rooftop to finally face off against Kaido and Big Mom.

1016.t: The Battle of the Monsters! The Three Stubborn Captains!
1016.o: Luffy’s strong attack reminds Kaido of all the strong ones he’s ever met. On the other hand, Luffy, Law, and Kid keep quarreling amongst themselves. Meanwhile, Sanji is caught and interrogated by Black Maria in what he calls “heaven.”

1017.t: Barrage of Powerful Techniques! The Fierce Attacks of the Worst Generation!
1017.o: Luffy, Law, Kid, Zoro, and Killer keep landing hard blows against Kaido in tandem despite the arguing. However, when Big Mom steps in and unleashes powerful lightning strikes, the tide turns for all except one of the rookies.

1018.t: Kaido Laughs! The Emperors of the Sea vs. the New Generation!
1018.o: Luffy pummels Kaido with his well-trained Kong Gatling and delivers a final blow using all his strength. Big Mom tries to fight back, but Law gets in her way and Kid and Killer also try to finish Kaido off.

1019.t: Otama’s Secret Plan! Operation Kibi Dango!
1019.o: After watching the Straw Hats’ departure to Onigashima, Tama wondered if there was anything she could do to help the Straw Hats and the samurai. Now that she’s here on Onigashima, it’s time to execute her powerful plan – Operation Kibi Dango!

1020.t: Sanji’s Scream! An SOS Echoes Over the Island!
1020.o: Sanji is captured and tortured by the merciless Black Maria. She names the terms of his release: to turn over one of his crewmates. He hesitates but has no other option. After much distress, he makes a move that surprises everyone.

1021.o: Robin bursts in to rescue Sanji along with Brook, and faces Black Maria, who is trying to keep Sanji as her pet. Meanwhile, Yamato, Momonosuke, and Shinobu are spotted hiding by the enemy, and they find themselves on the run again.

1022.t: No Regrets! Luffy and Boss, a Master-Disciple Bond!
1022.o: Chopper works hard to make the cure for Ice Oni, even though he is turning into one himself. Meanwhile, the infected Boss Hyogoro the Flower regains his youth and fights fiercely to protect Chopper and the others.

1023.o: Seeing everyone turning into Ice Oni, there is nothing that the samurai warriors can do other than grieve. However, it wasn’t just them who were devastated by Queen’s raging virus. When their desperation and frustration peak, they hear a hopeful voice.

1024.t: Oden Appears! The Confused Hearts of the Akazaya Members!
1024.o: That unparalleled laugh! The Akazaya regain hope upon witnessing Oden's return. They failed in their attempt to take down Kaido, but after twenty years, they team up with Oden again to finish the job!

1025.t: The Worst Generation Gets Wiped Out?! The Emperors’ Deadly Attack!
1025.o: The Akazaya members run to save Momonosuke, but an unexpected contender stands in their way. Queen gets infuriated after Chopper ruined his plot and goes after him. Meanwhile, on the rooftop, Kaido and Big Mom unleashes a combination attack on Luffy and the others.

1026.t: The Supernovas Strike Back! The Mission to Tear Apart the Emperors!
1026.o: The returned Orochi clashes the Akazaya members who are trying to save Momonosuke. Meanwhile, Luffy and the others are all covered in bruises, but they unite their strength and launch an attack.

1027.t: Defend Luffy! Zoro and Law’s Sword Technique!
1027.o: Even after Big Mom was pushed off of the island, Zoro and the others keep fighting the exhausting battle against Kaido. When Kaido tries to beat up the unconscious Luffy, Zoro launches an all-out attack at the risk of his life.

1028.t: Surpass the Emperor of the Sea! Luffy Strikes Back with an Iron Fist!
1028.o: Luffy remembers how he was advised by his friends, how he was saved by his comrades, and the frustrations of being defeated. As Kaido mocks him to his face, the Color of the Supreme King Haki gushes out and they clash again.

1029.t: A Faint Memory! Luffy and Red-Haired’s Daughter Uta!
1029.o: A young Luffy who has been dreaming about getting out of Windmill Village one day to accomplish something great meets a young girl named Uta who came along with Shanks and the Red-Hair Pirates calling herself the musician of the pirate group.

1030.t: A Pledge for the New Genesis! Luffy and Uta!
1030.o: Luffy and Uta run across Windmill Village, compete with each other, and share their dreams with each other. They also pledge to build a new genesis for everyone to live happily. However, one day, the unexpected happens.

1031.t: Nami Screams - A Deadly Death Race!
1031.o: Luffy and Kaido who have both infused themselves with the Color of the Supreme King clash! Meanwhile, Nami, Usopp, and Tama are running from Page One to get to the Performance Floor, but they bump into another tough enemy, Big Mom.

1032.t: The Dawn of the Land of Wano! The All-Out Battle Heats Up!
1032.o: Kin’emon and the Akazaya members are rushing to help Momonosuke and everyone else while Yamato leaves Momonosuke and Shinobu in a hide-out to lure away their enemies. At the same time, Ulti tries to avenge her brother against Big Mom.

1033.t: The Conclusion! Luffy, Accelerating Fist of the Supreme King
1033.o: Sanji is forced to run with Zoro on his shoulder. Meanwhile, Nami bravely stands up against Ulti and Big Mom. On the rooftop, the intense battle between Luffy and Kaido finally comes to an end.

1034.t: Luffy, Defeated! The Straw Hats in Jeopardy?!
1034.o: Luffy is pushed off the rooftop by Kaido. Meanwhile, Zeus intervenes in a fight between Big Mom and Nami’s group and stands up for the one who he wants to save. On the Performance Floor, Chopper is in a fierce battle against Queen.

1035.t: The Animal Kingdom Pirates Trample Down! The End of the Kozuki Clan!
1035.o: While the Straw Hats and their allies are all having a hard time, they are shocked by the news that Luffy lost to Kaido. At the same time, Kanjuro closes in on Momonosuke to destroy the Kozuki lineage.

1036.t: Fight Against the Dark Night! The Commander-in-chief of the Land of Wano Sounds Off!
1036.o: Like all the other samurai, Chopper is discouraged by the news of Luffy’s loss and Queen doesn’t miss the chance to finish him off! Meanwhile, Kin’emon fights for his life to save Momonosuke and that motivates Momonosuke to rise up!

1037.t: Believe in Luffy! The Alliance’s Counterattack Begins!
1037.o: Momonosuke and Shinobu face Kaido while Kid and Law challenge Big Mom. Meanwhile, Nami, heading towards the stage on the Performance Floor along with Usopp and Tama, hears a strange voice.

1038.t: Nami’s Lethal Attack! Otama’s Desperate Challenge!
1038.o: Nami strikes a thunder blast to clear the way to the stage on the Performance Floor. However, the elite corps of the Gifters shows up to crush their inferior opponents. Upset but unbroken, Otama stands up to give a command!

1039.t: A Dramatic Increase of Allies! Straw Hats Fight Back!
1039.o: Hearing Otama’s command, the Gifters side with the samurai and upset the Tobi Roppo and others! Chopper starts to take care of Zoro while suffering from the side effect of the enhanced Rumble Ball. Meanwhile, Jimbei gets stunned by Who’s-Who’s story.

1040.t: The Pride of a Helmsman! The Enraged Jimbei!
1040.o: Who’s-Who expresses fierce resentment toward Luffy and Jimbei fights back out of his loyalty to Luffy. As Who’s-Who asks Jimbei a question, he tramples on the dignity of the Fish-Men and that sparks Jimbei’s outrage.

1041.t: Showdown Battles of the Monsters! Yamato and Franky
1041.o: To cut ties with Kaido, Yamato unleashes his true power. Meanwhile, Queen repeatedly attacks Sanji with his power as a cyborg, and Sasaki in his Man-Beast Form launches tricky attacks on Franky and drives him into a corner.

1042.t: The Predator’s Trap - Black Maria’s Temptation!
1042.o: Kaido tries to convince Yamato to become the Shogun of the Land of Wano and rule the country with the special power he obtained by accident. Meanwhile, Saul, Professor Clover, and Robin’s mother Olvia suddenly appear in front of her.

1043.t: Slash the Nightmare! Brook Draws His Freezing Sword!
1043.o: In the dense mist, Brook is surprised to see his old friends, the Rumbar Pirates and Laboon. They reminisce about the old days and play music together, however, they suddenly attack Brook.

1044.o: Black Maria torments Robin both physically and spiritually. As she burns in hellfire, Robin remembers the people who gave her a hard time and the people who supported her, and she as Demon Child shows what she is really capable of.

1045.t: A Spell! Kid and Zoro Facing Threats!
1045.o: Killer is shocked to find out who Hawkins’ straw doll he slashed represents. Meanwhile, Sanji who is in a hard battle against Queen and King sees enemy brutes going after the injured Zoro, and no one else is there to save him.

1046.t: Taking a Chance! The Two Arms Go into Battle!
1046.o: Zoro gets back on his feet and along with Sanji, confronts King and Queen, the Lead Performers of the Animal Kingdom Pirates. Watching Zoro fight, Hyogoro and Kawamatsu remember someone from way back.

1047.t: Ascend to the Dawn! A Pink Dragon Gets Agitated
1047.o: Dogstorm confronts his sworn enemy who destroyed his country. Meanwhile, Cat Viper faces Perospero who is responsible for Pedro’s death. At Tokage Port, Momonosuke roars with his determined eyes.

1048.t: For the Future! Yamato and the Great Swordsmen’s Pledge
1048.o: The battle between Kaidou and Yamato gets intense. Backed into a corner, Yamato remembers three great swordsmen who he met when he was a child. Their stunning choice for the future of the Land of Wano encourages Yamato.

1049.t: Luffy Soars! Revenge Against the King of the Beasts
1049.o: Luffy amps up the reluctant Momonosuke, who is afraid of heights, in his giant pink dragon form, to fly and take him to Onigashima in the sky. Meanwhile, Yamato, in a hard battle against Kaido, vows to survive until Luffy returns.

1050.t: Two Dragons Face Off! Momonosuke’s Determination!
1050.o: Momonosuke faces Kaido once again trembling in fear. However, with Luffy’s encouragement, he bravely steps up and shows his dragon fangs remembering what he had to go through because of Kaido.

1051.t: A Legend All Over Again! Luffy’s Fist Roars in the Sky
1051.o: Yamato helps Momonosuke conquer his fear of flying and the two take on the most important task of saving Onigashima. Meanwhile, Luffy and Kaidou clash which parts the heavens. The clear skies help Inuarashi and Nekomamushi finally defeat their foes.

1052.t: The Situation Has Grown Tense! The End of Onigashima!
1052.o: Realizing Onigashima’s impending threat, imperiling everyone’s life, Yamato and Momonosuke launch a secret operation. Meanwhile, Sanji and Zoro are both in a deadly battle against Queen and King.

1053.t: Sanji's Mutation - The Two Arms in Crisis!
1053.o: Queen’s unforeseen move stuns everyone on the Performance Floor. And then, he goes on to utilize another special technique which can break every bone in Sanji’s body. On the verge of a crisis, Sanji feels something strange again.

1054.t: Death to Your Partner! Killer's Deadly Gamble!
1054.o: Killer tries to figure out how to fight against Hawkins whose power enables him to transfer damage against him to Kid. Kid is dying not knowing where his damage is coming from. Killer takes a chance with Kid’s life on the line.

1055.t: A Shadowy Figure Pulls the Strings! Onigashima in Flames
1055.o: Sanji still wonders what is happening to his body as he receives attacks. Meanwhile, the dying Kin’emon hears an unexpected voice calling for the also dying Kanjuro. Through the Smail, the voice of Orochi tries to stir up Kanjuro to make him perform one last time.

1056.t: Strike Back! Law and Kid's Counterattack Alliance
1056.o: Law and Kid are having a tough battle against a formidable Emperor of the Sea, Big Mom. However, when they decide to work collaboratively and use their awakened Devil Fruit powers, they see the possibility of taking down the old generation.

1057.t: For Luffy - Sanji and Zoro's Oath
1057.o: Sanji is tormented by the idea of becoming a cruel Germa warrior like his siblings and torn between being strong or being humane as he is now. When he makes up his mind, he asks Zoro the ultimate favor.

1058.t: The Onslaught of Kazenbo - Orochi's Evil Clutches Close in
1058.o: The chaos within the floating island of Onigashima rages on to seemingly no end. Kazenbo, Kajuro's creation, is wreaking havoc all throughout the Skull Dome in the name of vengence for the Kurozami. The rampage causes panic among Beasts Pirates and samurai, alike. As Orochi watches on, he hears a sound that reminds him of his past love.

1059.t: Zoro's Hardship - A Monster! King the Wildfire
1059.o: Zoro is facing a hard fight against King who seems invincible. Even one of Zoro’s deadliest attacks doesn’t leave a scratch on him. On top of that, one of Zoro’s swords goes out of control and gets in his way.

1060.t: Secrets of Enma! The Cursed Sword Entrusted to Zoro
1060.o: Zoro still can’t gain control of Enma which keeps extracting his Haki. Backed into a corner by the formidable King, Zoro remembers the encounter with an old man in his hometown when he was a child.

1061.t: The Strike of an Ifrit! Sanji vs. Queen
1061.o: Queen’s formidable attacks remind Sanji of his family. Annoyed by Queen’s provocations, Sanji remembers a young woman mysteriously getting hurt in front of him and realizes what happened at that time, which lights a fire within him.

1062.t: The Three-Sword Style of the Supreme King! Zoro vs. King
1062.o: Zoro tries to figure out a way to damage King. Meanwhile, King remembers when he first met his captain Kaido and declares that his captain is the one to become the King of the Pirates, which leads Zoro to set his swords alight with hellfire.

1063.t: Luffy is on the Move! A Turning Point of a New Era!
1063.o: Usopp finds Kin’emon’s upper body and the heavily wounded Kiku. However, they are surrounded by the Gifters and can’t find a way out. Seeing the samurai giving up hope, Usopp remembers his determination.

1064.t: Drunken Dragon Bagua! The Lawless Dragon Closing in on Luffy
1064.o: In the Flower Capital, the Fire Festival is about to end. On Onigashima, the battle between Luffy and Kaido is getting even more intense. However, Kaido who is excited about having a strong opponent starts drinking too much.

1065.t: The Destruction of the Alliance?! Fire up, the Will of the New Generation!
1065.o: With the ongoing battles in various parts of Onigashima, everyone is reaching their limits. In the face of Big Mom, Law and Kid are exhausted and deeply wounded. Mocking them, Big Mom tries to head for the rooftop.

1066.t: Here Comes the Main Act! Powerful Techniques of Shockwave and Magnetism!
1066.o: Big Mom’s strong life force discourages Law and Kid. Law tells Kid that he only has enough energy for one last strike. However, a monster Big Mom summons puts the two in even more of a bind.

1067.t: To the New Era! Settled! The Determination of the Brats
1067.o: Kid’s all-out deadly attack and Law’s tactical action leave Big Mom in the lurch. Then she remembers what Roger said in the past and wonders if the treasure he mentioned is out there after all.

1068.t: Moon Princess Echoes! The Final Phase of the Land of Wano!
1068.o: Kaido mourns Big Mom’s defeat and remembers the day he met her for the first time. Meanwhile, backed into a corner, Orochi sees the true nature of Komurasaki, the woman he loves, and trembles with fear.

1069.t: There is Only One Winner - Luffy vs. Kaido
1069.o: On orders from the Five Elders, the CP-0 agent Guernica tries to get to Luffy, but Drake stands in his way. Meanwhile, Luffy who only has very little energy left uses his last Gear Four to emancipate the people of the Land of Wano from Kaido.

1070.t: Luffy Is Defeated?! The Determination of Those Left Behind
1070.o: The battle between Luffy and Kaido comes to an unexpected end. Kaido comes down and tells everyone that Luffy has been defeated and the Land of Wano is finished. Momonosuke and Yamato argue over whether they should still continue fighting.

1071.o: As Luffy's heart pounds in a funny way, the Five Elders reveal the secret behind the Gum-Gum Fruit. Meanwhile, Orochi tries to convince Komurasaki to escape with him, but when he sees Kanjuro, he makes a malicious decision.

1072.t: The Ridiculous Power! Gear Five in Full Play
1072.o: Bouncing on the ground and becoming a giant, Luffy enjoys his new, bizarre power while Kaido is bewildered and can’t make sense of it. Meanwhile, Kid, Law, and Luffy’s other allies continue the fight down below against flames and enemies alike, waiting for Luffy to emerge victorious.

1073.t: No Way Out! A Hellish Scene on Onigashima
1073.o: As Luffy and Kaidou continue their battle, Raizo and Jinbe utilize their plan to put out the fire that has spread throughout Onigashima. Meanwhile, Yamato warns Momonosuke of the danger Onigashima will face if he does not act soon to create new flame clouds to keep it from crashing into the Flower Capital.

1074.t: I Trust Momo - Luffy's Final Powerful Technique!
1074.o: Momonosuke struggles to create Flame Clouds to sustain Onigashima which is in free fall. In the Flower Capital, the Fire Festival is ending with people flying their Sky Boats in the air. To fulfill the promise to free the Land of Wano, Luffy inflates his fist to strike Kaido.

1075.t: 20 Years' Worth of Prayers! Take Back the Land of Wano!
1075.o: When Oden died 20 years ago, Orochi took over the Land of Wano. People were separated from their loved ones, forced into labor, and starved. Now they pray that Kaido will vanish as Luffy’s battle against him reaches a climax.

1076.o: Kaido remembers how he was treated unfairly in the past and how he believes the world should be. While his friends struggle to survive on Onigashima, Luffy is asked by Kaido to picture his ideal world as he throws a destructive punch.

1077.t: The Curtain Falls! The Winner, Straw Hat Luffy!
1077.o: The samurai and the Straw Hats shout for joy as they hear that Luffy defeated Kaido. Meanwhile, Momonosuke informs Zunesha of a major decision that he made. However, when Yamato calls on the Animal Kingdom Pirates to stop fighting, the earth trembles.

1078.t: He Returns! The Shogun of the Land of Wano, Kozuki Momonosuke
1078.o: The people of the Flower Capital get flustered when Kin’emon and the other Akazaya samurai who were supposed to be dead appear from the smoke. However, the last one who walks out of the smoke, and what he says, confuses the people even more.

1079.t: The Morning Comes! Luffy and the Others Rest!
1079.o: The Land of Wano is in a celebratory mood now that the years of tyranny are over. However, Yamato is holding back his hunger alone until Hiyori arrives with the news he was waiting for. Meanwhile, some unknown figure approaches the Land of Wano.  Momonosuke announces to the citizens his victory and the return of the Kozuki Family. Tama remembers her childhood, and Yamato asks to join Luffy's crew.

1080.t: A Celebration Banquet! The New Emperors of the Sea!
1080.o: The news of the defeat of the Emperors of the Sea spreads across the world. Luffy enjoys the banquet but just as he is about to make a toast, an enraged Kid comes in to strike him. The reason behind his action surprises Luffy

1081.t: The World Will Burn! The Onslaught of a Navy Admiral!
1081.o: As the Navy Admiral Ryokugyu comes to strike the Flower Capital, the Akazaya samurai notice and try to stop him, but his Woods-Woods Fruit power overwhelms them. Meanwhile, another formidable, yet friendly, guest approaches the Land of Wano

1082.t: The Coming of the New Era! The Red-Haired's Imperial Rage
1082.o: Navy Admiral Ryokugyu keeps up a savage assault against the Akazaya samurai who are still recovering from the last battle. Momonosuke tries to defend the Land of Wano with all his might, but he gets driven into a corner.

1083.t: The World That Moves On! A New Organization, Cross Guild
1083.o: Momonosuke and Hiyori are happy to see their grandfather who was supposed to be dead and the Straw Hats are surprised when Robin tells them about Pluton the Ancient Weapon. Meanwhile, Momonosuke is kept busy in his role as the new Shogun.

1084.t: Time to Depart - The Land of Wano and the Straw Hats
1084.o: An untold story from before the Straw Hats’ departure. Luffy visits the ruins of Oden Castle where Oden’s grave once was and Zoro visits Yasuie’s grave where he meets Hiyori. Later, Luffy and Tama eat red-bean soup together for the last time and share their feelings with each other.

1085.t: The Last Curtain! Luffy and Momonosuke's Vow
1085.o: Angered by Luffy's attempt to leave without saying goodbye, Momonosuke rushes with Kin’emon and Yamato to the port from where the Straw Hats are about to leave, thinking back on his days with Luffy.

1086.t: A New Emperor! Buggy the Genius Jester!
1086.o: Luffy and the other Straw Hats’ new bounties are revealed. Meanwhile, at Emptee Bluffs Island,　Crocodile and the greatest swordsman in the world Mihawk, visit Buggy to discuss their newly-established organization, Cross Guild.

1087.t: The War on the Island of Women! A Case Involving Koby the Hero
1087.o: Navy Captain Koby comes to the Island of Women to arrest Pirate Empress Hancock with the new Pacifistas. While the Navy and Kuja fighters clash, Blackbeard comes to raid, also targeting Hancock.

1088.o: The three-way struggle between the Navy, the Blackbeard Pirates, and the Kuja Pirates comes to an end when an unexpected figure shows up. On the Sunny, the Straw Hats talk about the recent incidents around the world and Luffy’s words surprise everyone.

1089.t: Entering a New Chapter! Luffy and Sabo's Paths!
1089.o: Sabo, the Chief of Staff of the Revolutionary Army, contacts Koala and everyone in Kamabakka Queendom. He explains to them about the things that he is accused of, but someone who was eavesdropping on the call takes a stunning action.

1090.t: A New Island! Future Island Egghead
1090.o: Luffy and Chopper fall into the rough cold sea along with the mysterious girl. Jimbei tries to help them but another attack comes from the unknown creature. Meanwhile, the Sunny is hit by torpedoes and the rest of the Straw Hats are thrown into the sea, too.

1091.t: Brimming with the Future! An Adventure on the Island of Science!
1091.o: A young girl who came out of the big robot names herself Dr. Vegapunk and it surprises Franky and the rest of the Straw Hats. Meanwhile, Luffy’s group gets to the surface of the island where futuristic buildings stand and unknown giant creatures wander about.

1092.t: Bonney's Lamentation! Darkness Lurking on the Future Island
1092.o: While Luffy and the others are enjoying the futuristic machines of Egghead, someone who resembles Bartholomew Kuma comes after them. When Luffy tries to fight back, Bonney stops him and reveals her shocking relationship with Kuma.

1093.t: The Winner Takes All! Law vs. Blackbeard!
1093.o: The Blackbeard Pirates ambushed the Heart Pirates led by Law. The Blackbeard Pirates’ top officers use a variety of formidable Devil Fruit powers and keep pushing the Heart Pirates in order to obtain the copies of the Road Ponegliffs.

1094.o: The Straw Hats without Luffy, Chopper, and Jimbei are taken to the laboratory on the clouds far above the ground by Lilith. They get excited about the things they've never seen before. However, inside the laboratory, a new threat is waiting for them.

1095.t: The Brain of a Genius - Six Vegapunks!
1095.o: Nami and the others are attacked by a Pacifista who resembles Jimbei and while they’re in battle, some of Vegapunk’s Satellites look on with excitement. Meanwhile, Luffy and the others find something extraordinary at the scrap heap.

1096.t: A Forbidden Piece of History! A Theory Concerning a Kingdom
1096.o: Vegapunk Shaka shares with Robin and the others his theory about an ancient kingdom and the 100-Year Void. He even says that he visited Ohara after its destruction. Meanwhile, Luffy and Chopper try to activate the giant robot and something surprising happens.

1097.t: The Will of Ohara! The Inherited Research
1097.o: Shaka reveals the secret behind the foundation of the Revolutionary Army and how the relationship between Vegapunk and Dragon affected it. Meanwhile, Vegapunk explains to Luffy and the others about his special power and how his clones work.

1098.t: The Eccentric Dream of a Genius!
1098.o: Vegapunk reveals the shocking history of the ancient giant robot and asks Luffy to take him off Egghead. Rob Lucci and his fellow Cipher Pol agents arrive at the island and ask for permission to enter the port.

1099.t: Preparations for Interception! Rob Lucci Strikes!
1099.o: CP-0 led by Rob Lucci makes a forced landing at Egghead and people on the Fabriophase are plunged into confusion while Shaka and the others prepare to fight back on the Labophase. The enraged Atlas stands up to defend the peace of the island.

1100.t: Powers on a Different Level! Luffy vs. Lucci!
1100.o: Luffy transforms into the Warrior of Liberation as Rob Lucci also shows his awakened Devil Fruit form. As the two clash, Vegapunk reveals the shocking truth of the Gum-Gum Fruit and his eye-opening theory on Devil Fruits.

1101.t: The Strongest Form of Humanity! The Seraphim's Powers!
1101.o: Vegapunk describes how he managed to grant the Seraphim Devil Fruit powers, which surprises Franky and the others. Meanwhile, Luffy is still facing Lucci in his savage, awakened form, but the rocket to the Labophase is about to leave.

1102.t: Sinister Schemes! The Operation to Escape Egghead
1102.o: Vegapunk asks the Straw Hats to take him on board their ship which makes Franky and Usopp happy but annoys Nami. Lucci orders his troops to block off all Vegapunk’s escape routes and looks to invade the heavily-secured Labophase.

1103.t: Turn Back My Father! Bonney's Futile Wish!
1103.o: CP-0 enters the Labophase and starts attacking the Thousand Sunny as soon as they find it. Luffy reunites with Nami and the others but finds out that Vegapunk is missing. Meanwhile, Bonney is pressing Vegapunk to change back her father Kuma.

1104.t: A Desperate Situation! The Seraphim's All-out Attack!
1104.o: The Seraphim come following CP-0 to the Labophase, pitting Zoro and Brook against the seven of them. Sanji, Franky, Edison, and Lilith leave the lab to fight them, but the Seraphim launch a full-scale attack on the lab.

1105.t: A Beautiful Act of Treason! The Spy, Stussy
1105.o: Stussy suddenly knocked out Lucci to the Straw Hats’ surprise, and when Shaka reveals her true identity, they’re stunned again. Meanwhile, a major incident occurs on an island called Sphinx where Whitebeard came from.

1106.o: CP-0 takes control of the Fabriophase but gets attacked by an unknown force. Meanwhile, in the Labophase, the Straw Hats and Dr. Vegapunk’s Satellites find out that Vegapunk has disappeared and begin searching for him.

1107.t: A Shudder! The Evil Hand Creeping Up on the Laboratory
1107.o: Bonney witnesses her father Bartholomew Kuma’s painful memories. Meanwhile at the lab, Shaka notices that their communications and surveillance cameras are being cut off by somebody.

1108.o: The Seraphim suddenly start attacking the Straw Hats and the Vegapunk Satellites. They are not stopping even when the Satellites order them to. When Luffy and Zoro are cornered, Lucci and Kaku wake up and make them a surprising offer.

1109.t: A Tough Decision! An Unusual United Front!
1109.o: Lucci and Kaku from CP-0, who came to Egghead with a mission to eliminate the seven Vegapunks, ask Luffy and Zoro to uncuff them so they can fight alongside them against the Seraphim, but Luffy and Zoro are reluctant to do so.

1110.t: Survive! Deadly Combat with the Strongest Form of Humanity!
1110.o: The Straw Hats and CP-0 relentlessly attack the Seraphim, but the Seraphim keep getting back up. Then, Zoro notices that the Seraphim remind him of someone who he fought before. Meanwhile, Shaka goes to check one place where he thinks Vegapunk Stella might be.

1111.t: The Second Ohara! The Mastermind's Ambition!
1111.o: Stussy and Sentomaru discuss how big the threat that closes in on Egghead is as Luffy and the others keep fighting the uncontrollable Seraphim. Meanwhile, in an underground lab, someone approaches Vegapunk, who is being held captive.

1112.o: Kid gives his crew a pep talk before the battle with Shanks. And Shanks also prepares for the battle but learns how his own subordinates do as they like to protect their beloved boss. Finally, Kid has his Damned Punk ready to shoot.

1113.t: Run, Koby! A Desperate Escape Strategy!
1113.o: Perona breaks into the Blackbeard Pirates' prison to rescue her captain, Gecko Moria, and frees Koby, who then helps free other prisoners. Koby, now with a high bounty, distracts a mob of pirates to protect the others. He recalls Blackbeard's plan to trade him for Hachinosu's entry into the World Government. The pirates face attacks from clay golems, SWORD member Kujaku, and a Marine force led by Garp and Tashigi.

1114.t: For the Beloved Pupil - The Fist of Vice Admiral Garp!
1114.o: A massive warship comes flying towards the Pirate Island of Beehive and Vice Admiral Garp launches a crushing attack on top of it to save his pupil Koby. Koby almost reaches the ship with Navy HQ Commander Hibari running by his side.

1115.t: The Navy Surprised! The Navy Headquarters' Former Admiral, Kuzan
1115.o: Kuzan, a former Navy Admiral, stands in the way of Garp who came to rescue Koby. He was once Garp’s pupil but is now a member of the Blackbeard Pirates. What happened to him after he was defeated by Sakazuki is now revealed.

1116.t: Let's Go Get It! Buggy's Big Declaration
1116.o: Sengoku, the former Admiral of the Fleet, and Great Adviser Tsuru discuss the murder of Vice Admiral T-Bone and concerns about Cross Guild. Meanwhile, Buggy gives a passionate speech to Crocodile, Mihawk, and his crew.

1117.t: Sabo Returns - The Shocking Truth to Be Told!
1117.o: Sabo returns to Kamabakka Queendom and starts recounting what happened at the Holy Land Mary Geoise. A month ago, during the Reverie, he and the captains of the Revolutionary Army raided the Land of Gods and Sabo witnessed Bartholomew Kuma being the Celestial Dragons’ slave.

1118.t: The Holy Land in Tumult! Sai and Leo's Full-Power Blow!
1118.o: In the Holy Land Mary Geoise during the Reverie, Sabo runs into Bartholomew Kuma’s daughter Bonney. Meanwhile, King Cobra of the Kingdom of Alabasta begins asking the Five Elders questions that trouble them.

1119.t: The Entrusted Message! King Cobra’s Resolve
1119.o: King Cobra is surprised by seeing someone sitting on the Empty Throne and by learning about the truth of the world. When he is subject to a deadly attack, Sabo cuts in to save him. The injured king entrusts Sabo with a message.

1120.t: The World Is Shaken! The Ruler's Judgment and the Five Elders' Actions!
1120.o: Vivi tries to escape the Holy Land Mary Geoise with Wapol while the injured Sabo also looks for a way to leave to deliver King Cobra’s message to Luffy and Vivi. Meanwhile, Imu orders the Five Elders to test a horrendous weapon.

1121.t: Garp and Kuzan - A Master and a Pupil's Beliefs Clash
1121.o: At the Pirate Island of Beehive, Vice Admiral Garp, who came to rescue the kidnapped Koby, deals with an overwhelming number of pirates alone. As he and his fellow Navy soldiers try to escape the island, Kuzan, the former Navy admiral, stands in their way.

1122.o: Avalo Pizarro, who merged with the Pirate Island, reaches his giant hand to crush the Navy ship with many soldiers and civilians on board. The wounded Garp gives orders to Koby, Helmeppo, and Prince Grus, and delivers a powerful blow to save the ship.

1123.t: The World Shakes! The Straw Hats' Hostage Situation
1123.o: As the news about Garp’s disappearance and Luffy’s hostage situation spreads, a mysterious earthquake suddenly shakes the entire world. Meanwhile, a huge Navy fleet led by Admiral Kizaru surrounds Egghead and listens in as York contacts Mary Geoise to negotiate a deal.

1124.t: Completely Surrounded! The Operation to Escape Egghead
1124.o: In the Labophase on Egghead, which is completely surrounded by the Navy, Luffy and the others devise a plan to escape the island. However, the Frontier Dome, the laser defense system, cannot be deactivated without York’s secret passcode.

1125.t: A Clash of Two Men's Determination! Kizaru and Sentomaru
1125.o: Navy Admiral Kizaru finally makes landfall on Egghead and Sentomaru, Vegapunk’s bodyguard, stands in his way. The two men who were once close now clash violently. Meanwhile, Luffy and the others try their best to move the Sunny to the back side of the island to escape.

1126.t: Looming Despair! Admiral Kizaru's Depressing Mission
1126.ar: في قبضة اليأس! مهمّة الأميرال كيزارو الحزينة
1126.o: وصل كوما إلى ماريجوا وهو بدون إرادة أو وعي، لكنّ أكاينو يقف في طريقه. وفي إيغهيد، يهاجم كيزارو لوفي بقوّة.

1127.t: Luffy vs. Kizaru!  A Fierce Kaleidoscopic Battle
1127.ar: لوفي ضدّ كيزارو! معركة شرسة متغيّرة بلا حدود
1127.o: تتصاعد المعركة بين لوفي وكيزارو. بوني مطارَدة ووحيدة، وفيغابانك يخاطر بحياته بمغادرته لللاّبوفيز لإنقاذها.

1128.t: The Nightmare Strikes - Godhead of Science & Defense, St. Saturn
1128.ar: هجوم كابوس - إله العلم والدّفاع الحربيّ، القدّيس ساترن
1128.o: يهاجم الباسيفيستا البحريّة بأمر من أطلس، ويبحث سانجي عن بوني. يغادر كيزارو للقضاء على فيغابانك، ويواجهه لوفي.

1129.t: Kuma's Past - Better Off Dead in This World
1129.ar: ماضي كوما - الموت أهون في هذا العالم
1129.o: يمسك ساترن ببوني بعد أن طعنته، وتسترجع ذكريات والدها كوما المولود قبل 47 عامًا من عِرق مهدد بالانقراض.

1130.t: A History Erased! God Valley of Despair
1130.ar: فصل محذوف من التّاريخ! يأس غود فالي
1130.o: تبدأ منافسة صيد البشر، ويكشف إيفانكوف وجيني خطّتهما للنّجاة منها بينما تصل سفن القراصنة إلى غود فالي.

1131.t: A Fleeting Moment of Happiness - Kumachi and Ginny
1131.o: Kuma and Ginny live peacefully in the Sorbet Kingdom eight years after the God Valley Incident. However, their new king initiates a policy of enslaving the poor. Kuma tries to free those who were captured but ends up being imprisoned himself. But a familiar face comes to rescue him.

1132.t: A Pledge to Ginny - Kuma Becomes a Father
1132.o: Two years after Ginny’s abduction, the Revolutionary Army suddenly receives a call from her.

1133.t: To Save His Daughter - Kuma the Timid Pacifist
1133.o: By fighting off King Bekori who is supported by the World Government, Kuma is put on the wanted list and decides to travel around the world in search of a cure for Bonney's disease. He reunites with Dragon and learns about the Government’s eccentric scientist who might be able to cure Bonney.

1134.t: Cruel Fate - Kuma's Decision as a Father
1134.o: Taking advantage of Kuma’s love for his daughter Bonney, the World Government imposes three harsh conditions on him in exchange for her treatment. Kuma agrees to them and Bonney’s treatment starts at Laboratory 8 in tandem with the clone development with which Kuma agrees to cooperate.

1135.t: To the Sea Where My Father Is! The Future Bonney Chooses
1135.o: Bonney has been waiting for a letter from her father Kuma who promised to write to her. But with no letters in sight, she turns nine and one day realizes her disease is cured. She then decides to go out to sea to search for her father.

1136.o: Bonney sails out to sea in search of her father and rises to prominence. At the same time, Luffy makes his name by defeating the Arlong Pirates and declaring war against the World Government. Watching his actions, Kuma begins to hold a certain belief.

1137.t: I'm Sorry, Dad - Bonney's Tears and Kuma's Fist
1137.o: The present day on Egghead, Bonney is caught in St. Saturn’s grasp, knowing he is responsible for her father’s transformation into a cyborg. However, Saturn reveals an even more shocking truth that throws Bonney into despair.

1138.t: Thank You, Dad - Bonney and Kuma's Warm Embrace
1138.o: Kuma, battered and without free will, approaches Bonney. Overcome with emotion, she tells him she saw all his memories and learned everything that he did for her. Watching the scene, Vegapunk wonders what compelled Kuma to come to Egghead.

1139.t: Destroy Egghead - The Buster Call Is Invoked
1139.o: As an order comes down to evacuate the island in preparation for bombardment, Navy soldiers rush to their ships. Meanwhile, Vegapunk pleads with Saturn to halt the attack, arguing how vital the island is for the future of humanity, but Saturn refuses to listen.

1140.t: An Admired Hero - The Warrior of Liberation Who Saves Bonney
1140.o: Vegapunk reveals the secret he alone has been keeping regarding the Pacifistas. Meanwhile, Bonney, her back against the wall, hears a familiar rhythm. It’s the rhythm that her father taught her along with the legend of the hero he admired.

1141.t: Reliable Reinforcements! Dorry and Brogy Arrive!
1141.o: The Giant Pirate Crew led by Dorry and Brogy arrive at Egghead, which deeply moves Usopp and the others. Zoro keeps fighting Rob Lucci and the Pacifistas continues to torment the Navy while Luffy shows Bonney how to throw a real punch.

1142.o: Caribou begs Augur and Devon to let him meet Blackbeard. An order is given to the Navy vice admirals to kill Jewelry Bonney at all costs in order to take back control over the Pacifistas. Sanji flees with the injured Vegapunk while Luffy holds St. Saturn back.

1143.t: Vegapunk's Secret Plan - A Tense Worldwide Broadcast
1143.o: Suddenly, Vegapunk’s broadcast begins and the whole world is taken by surprise. As everyone rushes to set up Video Transponder Snails and screens to watch it, the Five Elders grow concerned and discuss countermeasures.

1144.t: The Worst Nightmare - The Five Elders Come Together
1144.o: Just like when St. Saturn emerged on Egghead, black lightning strikes and pentagrams appear again. The Pacifistas are rendered immobile by an unknown shadow. Meanwhile, as the time for the Straw Hats to evacuate the island is drawing near, the fight between Zoro and Lucci intensifies.

1145.t: Friends Fight Together! Luffy and the Warriors of Elbaph
1145.o: Dorry and Brogy finally reunite with Luffy. However, they are still facing St. Saturn and St. Warcury in their alternate forms. Dorry blows a horn to alert his people to prepare to escape, but St. Warcury unleashes a deafening roar.

1146.t: An Imminent Threat - Stussy and Edison's Resolve
1146.o: Franky and Bonney clash with Navy vice admirals in front of the Elbaph ship. St. Mars tries to find the room from Vegapunk’s broadcast. The heavily injured Stussy tells Kaku the reason she chose to stay behind while Edison takes desperate action to help the Straw Hats escape.

1147.t: A Stunning Conclusion - Vegapunk's Great Prediction
1147.o: Vegapunk’s broadcast resumes as people in various locations all over the world listen closely. St. Mars rushes to find the Transponder Snail that is the source of the broadcast while the Straw Hats and their allies clash with the other members of the Five Elders.

1148.t: The Lost History - Joyboy, the First Pirate
1148.o: Vegapunk's revelation sends shockwaves around the world. St. Saturn abandons his fight with Nami and the others and rushes to stop the broadcast at all costs. Vegapunk goes on to expose another stunning truth, this time about Joyboy, the first pirate.

1149.t: The Void Century - A Revelation About a Sinking World
1149.o: The severely injured Edison begs Stussy to escape, but she makes a stunning request in exchange. Meanwhile, Vegapunk presents another astonishing disclosure about a past cataclysm and the Ancient Weapons that will fundamentally challenge the beliefs of people everywhere.

1150.t: Get the Ship Moving! The Iron Giant Activates
1150.o: Vegapunk’s revelation shocks even Koby and his fellow SWORD members, leading them to discuss what to do next.

1151.t: Her and Her Father's Dream! Bonney's Free Future
1151.o: Luffy finally hops on the Elbaph ship along with Dorry and Brogy, but the Five Elders catch up to them and begin their assault. Aboard the burning ship, Bonney hears a familiar sound and then finds a new strength in her memories of her father.

1152.t: Her Father and Mother's Legacy! Bonney's Nika Punch
1152.o: Zoro and the others who are on the Sunny in the Labophase finally attempt to escape, but at the cost of an unexpected sacrifice. Meanwhile, as Vegapunk concludes his speech, Bonney once again faces St. Saturn, the object of her great hatred.

1153.t: The Upheaval of an Era! The Color of the Supreme King That Leads Luffy
1153.o: Vegapunk's speech raises the spirits of the pirates across the world, infuriating the Navy and the civilians. However, the broadcast is suddenly cut off while Vegapunk is still speaking. Meanwhile, off the coast of Egghead, the Five Elders are about to deliver the Straw Hats and the Giants a deadly strike.

1154.t: The Truth Behind the Secret Plan - Vegapunk Claims Victory
1154.o: Two weeks before the battle erupted on Egghead, Vegapunk found out someone stole a portion of the Mother Flame. Along with Pythagoras and Shaka, he launched an investigation and identified the culprit, also learning their shocking motivation. Then, for the future of humanity, he resolved himself to make a bold decision.

1155.t: The Promised Horizon - Off to the Long-Awaited Elbaph!
1155.o: York wakes up to see Island Clouds rising, and to her surprise, something is about to be taken away. Meanwhile, at Mary Geoise, the Celestial Dragons realize their food stock is dwindling and become belligerent. Another one of Vegapunk’s Satellites, Lilith wakes up and receives astonishing news.

1156.t: The Long-sought Elbaph! The Big Reunion Banquet!
1156.o: After leaving Egghead, the Straw Hats and the Giant Pirate Crew celebrate their reunion with a big banquet.

1157.t: Nami in a Fix! An Adventure in Block Kingdom
1157.o: Nami awakens to find herself in a completely unfamiliar place. Giant creatures attack one after another, driving her into a corner. At that moment, she hears a voice calling her name.

1158.t: A Quest in the Land of Mystery! The Secret of the Sun God
1158.o: Luffy and the others come across a warrior riding a grasshopper.

1159.t: Destroy the Miniature Garden - Escape Block Kingdom!
1159.o: Pursued by the Sun God, the Straw Hats flee across Block Kingdom at full speed. Amidst the chaos, the Sun God's true objective begins to surface. But as they run, another wall blocks their path. Their breakthrough rests on Luffy’s fists.

1160.t: An Encounter on a Snowfield - Loki, the Accursed Prince
1160.o: Leaving the Block Kingdom behind, Luffy and the others find themselves facing a vast snowy landscape and a massive suspension bridge. They resolve to move forward, only to be halted by approaching figures and a mysterious roar.

1161.t: A Dangerous Deal! Loki of the Underworld and Luffy
1161.o: Luffy encounters Loki, the Accursed Prince, who offers him a deal. He hints at a connection to Shanks, all while savage beasts crowd around, staring Luffy down. Meanwhile, Zoro and the others on the suspension bridge realize someone is following them.

1162.t: A Gargantuan Wave of Emotion - The Dreamlike Scenery of Elbaph
1162.o: As the Great Erik, carrying Robin and the others, reaches the island of Elbaph, a breathtaking rainbow stretches out before them. Yet even greater astonishment awaits them in the direction the ship is traveling.

1163.t: I Want You to Praise Me - The Reunion of Robin and Saul
1163.o: Robin and the others finally arrive at the port of the Western Village in Elbaph.

1164.t: Saul's Resolve - The Inherited Will of Ohara
1164.o: Robin formally introduces Luffy and the others to Saul. Then his assistant, Ange, shows them around the school, where Usopp is shocked by the education being provided there. Meanwhile, Robin is taken to the library by Saul, where she is met with an incredible sight.

1165.t: A Welcome with Friends' Cups and Intruders Seeking Loki
1165.o: Robin, Chopper, Bonney, and Lilith enjoy the Owl Library.

1166.t: Encountering Loki - Gunko of the Knights of God
1166.o: Amidst the roaring banquet with the Giants, Luffy hears the legend of the Sun God passed down in Elbaph and learns why Loki is being held captive. In the Underworld, two mysterious guests appear before Loki, expressing their desire to recruit him into their order of knights.

1167.t: Shamrock Appears - Commander of the Knights of God
1167.o: Luffy and some of his companions snuck out of the banquet to explore the deceased king's castle.

1168.t: Ancient History - The Harley Passed Down by Elbaph
1168.o: Leaving behind a brutal parting gift, Shamrock and Gunko of the Knights of God abandon Loki and move on to their next strategy. Meanwhile, Franky is shown old wall paintings, and Robin reads an important religious text passed down since ancient times in Elbaph.

1169.t: The Legend Lurking in Elbaph - The Identity of the Mountain-Eater
1169.o: While exploring the abandoned castle, Luffy and the others find a strange mark on the floor of the throne room and hear a mysterious voice out of nowhere. At the banquet, Oimo tells Usopp the tale of a legendary man linked to the Pirate King.

1170.t: Get the Key! Luffy vs. Scopper Gaban
1170.o: Gaban challenges Luffy to try to take the key from him. Luffy goes for it, only to be overpowered by Gaban's sheer force. Meanwhile, Shamrock and Gunko summon reinforcements and plot a detailed strategy to disorient the Giants.

1171.t: The Heinous Sinner - Loki of the Underworld Freed?!
1171.o: While observing the Jewel Tree Adam along with Ripley, Franky learns of Elbaph's weak points. Meanwhile, in the Underworld, Luffy and Zoro find a heavily injured Loki. As they argue over whether to unchain him, an unexpected turn of events blindsides them.

1172.t: Monsters Appear in Elbaph - "What I Fear Most"
1172.o: A massive snake suddenly attacks the Walrus School. Saul and the other teachers stand their ground to protect the children, but just then, another mystery strikes, plunging the school into pure panic.

1173.t: A Nightmarish Game - The Dark Plot of the Knights of God
1173.o: Saul tries to stop the marching children, but as he reaches out to them, some unknown force gets in his way. Meanwhile, hearing the school’s emergency call throws Dorry and the others at the Western Village into disarray, just as a monster appears before them as well.

1174.t: Save the Children! The Elbaph Warriors Rise Up
1174.o: As monsters assault villages throughout Elbaph, the Giants scramble to hold them back. Meanwhile, as the sleeping children get closer to the fire, Saul tries everything to stop them, but suddenly, he finds his efforts stymied.

1.o: Barry Al-Fayeed is a California pediatrician who also happens to be the second son of a Middle Eastern dictator. Barry reluctantly agrees to return home with his American family for his nephew's wedding. Events thrust him into the complex and turbulent growing pains of a nation straining to break free from dictatorial rule.

2.o: When Barry's older brother, Jamal, the newly appointed President of Abbudin, is incapacitated, Barry must put his plans to return to America on hold. His life is further complicated, when his nephew's new bride is kidnapped by terrorists.

3.o: While Barry’s decision to stay in Abbudin is met with mixed emotion, the discovery of new evidence connected to the attempted murder of Jamal threatens to drive a wedge between the two brothers.

4.o: Tensions boil as the 20th anniversary of the chemical attack ordered by Barry's father, President Khaled Al-Fayeed looms. Barry’s plan to defuse the situation runs into heavy resistance. Meanwhile, Jamal struggles to regain confidence in the bedroom.

5.o: As Jamal prepares to throw down the gauntlet on the thousands of citizens gathered in the Plaza to protest his reign, Barry scrambles to put together a summit in the hopes of avoiding violence and bloodshed.

6.o: Barry convinces Jamal to meet with exiled opposition leader Sheik Rashid. But when the meeting takes a turn for the worse, Jamal is forced to make a difficult decision that will impact the lives of his family and his country forever.

7.o: Jamal is terrified to discover that Sheik Rashid may actually survive Jamal's brutal attack, while Amira's disclosure of a twenty year old secret leads Barry to question everything he's ever believed about his father.

8.o: Fed up with Jamal's unpredictable and violent nature, Barry conspires to start a coup and remove his brother from office; while at the same time Jamal is so moved by Barry's willingness to do the unthinkable and hasten Sheik Rashid's demise, that he stops at nothing to prove his worth to his brother.

9.o: As the plans for the coup continue to take shape, Jamal proves how far he will go to punish those who oppose him, and Barry's relationship with Molly is pushed to the limit after she learns of the repercussions that await their family.

10.o: On the verge of betraying and displacing Jamal, Barry receives troublesome news that threatens to destroy everything he's worked so hard for. Meanwhile, Jamal's rising suspicions lead him to question the loyalty of those closest to him.

1.o: Barry waits to find out what his punishment will be for a failed coup, Jamal agonizes over the decision whether to execute him.

2.o: Molly returns to the U.S., but struggles to adjust to life without Barry. Meanwhile, Jamal deals with the loss of a close relative.

3.o: Barry ends up being taken in by a Bedouin family. Jamal is upset over Tariq's drastic military action.

4.o: Barry attempts to adjust to his new identity. A highly decorated war hero is introduced to Jamal.

5.o: The Army of the Caliphate arrives and Barry fears his identity will be revealed. Jamal and Tariq's conflict over military action reaches a tipping point. Molly and Sammy travel to Abuddin.

6.o: Barry opts to stay in Abbudin and take a stand against the Caliphate. Jamal leans on the Chinese diplomat to promise military support. Sammy is shocked to learn that Abdul has been kidnapped by the Caliphate.

7.o: Jamal feels his country is spiraling out of control and is desperate for a military victory - no matter the cost. Barry's attempt to rescue Daliyah has unintended consequences. Seeing he's on shaky ground, Rami consults with Amira on how to navigate Jamal's erratic behavior.

8.o: Suffering heavy losses, Barry wrestles with the notion that he needs the palace’s support to survive. As paranoia builds within Jamal, he questions where Rami’s loyalty lies. Stricken by Abdul’s death, Sammy plans to give his money to insurgents fighting the Army of the Caliphate.

1.o: With Jamal’s life in danger and Abuddin on the verge of plunging into chaos, Barry steps forward as interim president and sets the stage for democratic elections. Daliyah takes a leading role in the nation, bringing her close to Barry. Swept up in the tides of revenge, army leaders overstep their bounds in securing peace. An American General who shares history with Leila arrives in Abuddin.

2.o: Barry discovers that his hold over Abuddin is tenuous. Sammy embarks on a risky relationship. Ihab's desire for revenge is given an outlet. Fauzi returns to Abuddin and is thrust into a political role. Molly’s routine visit to a military hospital goes awry, spelling terrible consequences for the future of Abuddin.

5.o: In the wake of thwarted terrorist attacks, Barry bans open prayer at the University - causing a severe backlash. Al-Qadi speaks out against violence and restriction of religious freedom. Bereft and alone, Barry and Daliyah turn to each other for comfort. Leila’s campaign heats up, alongside her relationship with Cogswell.

6.o: Barry's tough policies put Daliyah in grave danger. Al-Qadi enacts a risky plan to broach peace. Fauzi puts his feelings on the line, leaving Daliyah conflicted. As the elections reel out of control, Barry cracks down on the political process. Leila's relationship with Cogswell creates a wedge between her and her sister.

8.o: Molly returns to Abuddin with a hardened resolve to pursue her daughter’s killer. Mahdiya is entrusted with a critical job. Leila and Cogswell relish in a brief escape from the world -- only to find that escape is impossible. Barry is thrown by Molly’s cold determination and haunted by images of the daughter he failed. Stuck between the woman he loves, the woman he loved, and the daughter he lost, Barry takes a hard line with the country.

9.o: Abuddin descends into chaos. Daliyah persuades Fauzi to leave so he can be a voice of dissent, and she takes a public stand against Barry. In an attempt to regain control, Barry gives Maloof authority to shut down Leila’s opposition, and Ahmed joins to pressure his mother to surrender. Cogswell makes a forceful move that puts his career in jeopardy.

10.o: Barry and Molly are on the brink of waging war on the Caliphate. Leila makes a bold political move and braves the possibility of a close betrayal. Barry and Daliyah face a final reckoning in their relationship. The conflict in Abuddin threatens to turn into a bloody civil war.

1.o: Court Lady Mishil seduces the kings of Shilla to gain enormous power and influence over the royal court, but a prophecy regarding twins promises her eventual downfall.

2.o: King Jinpyeong and Lady Maya have twin daughters, forcing the king to send the younger daughter away with the maid Sohwa before Mishil can get her hands on the girl.

3.o: Fifteen years later, Deokman lives a life of a merchant with her mother Sohwa. King Jinpyeong's line of male heirs comes to an end.

4.o: Deokman displays her wits against a Chinese official. Lady Mishil's personal guard Chilsuk finally tracks down Deokman as the twin, and attempts to kill her and Sohwa.

5.o: After her husband's death, Princess Chunmyung leaves for the countryside to give birth to her son and keep him far from the reaches of Mishil.

6.o: Chunmyung encounters Deokman and mistakes her for a boy. Deokman believes Chunmyung is a nun and saves her life.

7.o: Saved by Princess Cheonmyeong, Deokman feels somewhat intimate with her. Yusin saves Princess Cheonmyeong.

8.o: Deokman is arrested and brought to the palace, but Chunmyung intervenes and assigns her to be part of the Hwarang.

9.o: Yusin and The Followers of Maitreya return from the battle, only to face disdain from The Ten Elite Hwarang.

10.o: Yusin is being called to be under the command of Seolwon while Deokman stays in Amagseong Fortress.

11.o: Deokman survives an attack, but for Silla to win, Yushin's battered troops are forced to face the enemy once again, alone.

12.o: The Hwarang are rewarded for their achievements in battle. Deokman is arrested under suspicion of trying to assassinate Yushin's father.

13.o: Deokman discovers Chunmyung's true identity. Mishil's background is revealed and the source of her power is suspected to arrive at the palace through a foreign trading delegation.

14.o: The Sadaham Plum Blossom turns out to be an almanac. As Deokman tries to spy on Mishil, she discovers the true fate of Chilsuk.

15.o: Mishil attempts to discredit Deokman in front of Yushin and Chunmyung, but is thwarted. Instead, Deokman manages to get close to Mishil and spy on her for Chunmyung.

16.o: Using the almanac to her advantage, Mishil makes a prediction to manipulate the royal court. She attempts to bring Yushin over to her side.

17.o: Through Mishil, Deokman is one step closer to finding out her true identity. She attempts to meet with the king to answer her questions.

18.o: A theft among the Hwarang nearly forces Deokman to reveal her true gender, but Chunmyung's own questions and investigations lead her to learning the truth.

19.o: Chunmyung tries to send Deokman far from the palace and away from Mishil. Though unable to meet with the king, Deokman pursues a meeting with Queen Maya.

20.o: Princess Cheonmyeong tells Queen Maya that Deokman is her lost twin sister. Deokman tries to sort things out.

21.o: Yushin and Deokman go on the run as everyone in the palace realizes who Deokman is. Bidam, Mishil's secret son, appears.

22.o: Deokman and Yusin sneak into Yangjigol Village. Mishil and Jinpyeong are at odds with each other.

23.o: Yushin, Deokman, and Bidam form an unlikely alliance against Mishil's soldiers. Chunmyung searches for Deokman with Alchun and other Hwarang guards.

24.o: Hwarang Daenambo is sent to kill Deokman, but a case of mistaken identity leads to the wrong person getting killed.

25.o: With the death of Chunmyung, Deokman plans to take revenge and earn her rightful place in the royal family.

26.o: A public announcement is made that threatens the position of Queen Maya and King Jinpyeong. Meanwhile, Yusin must deal with a threat against his family from his own people.

27.o: Ill omens begin to appear around the palace. Deokman tries to extract information from a mystical monk that can help her return to the palace.

28.o: Deokman confuses Mishil with Bidam. When Mishil tries to burn Bidam, something unexpected happens.

29.o: The royal house acknowledges Deokman as the lost daughter and crowns her as princess, and heir to the throne. Immediately, she makes her first decree as a princess - to build an astronomy tower.

30.o: Deokman's decision to release the almanac to the public is met with some consternation even among her supporters.

31.o: Deokman brings Sohwa back to the palace with her. Mishil promotes Chilsook as the teacher of the Hwarang.

32.o: The Grand Marshal tournament begins, and the second question leads Deokman to discover a secret about the royal kings and Mishil.

33.o: Bidam learns about his identity while Yushin prepares to win the tournament and become Grand Marshal.

34.o: Yusin, Bidam, and Alcheon prepare for the upcoming third challenge duel and strengthen their determination.

35.o: Chilsook finds it hard to accept the results of the final duel between Bidam and Yusin, where Bidam loses.

36.o: Misil finds evidence against Yushin that could prevent him from becoming a Grand Marshal, and affect his loyalties.

37.o: Yusin tells Deokman how difficult it is to keep the trust between the sovereign and its subject.

38.o: The country turns into confusion with murders taking place as the price of grains skyrockets.

39.o: Deokman comes up with an idea to distribute the military rice to the people against the greedy nobles.

40.o: Despite the king's frail condition, Deokman does not want to marry, but expresses a desire to rule alone. She is not the only one who wants the throne.

41.o: Chunchu brings Boryang to his secret house. Seolwon suspects Sejong regarding Boryang's disappearance.

42.o: Misil takes a vacation, despite the turmoil within her camp, and returns with a stronger resolve to become queen.

43.o: Deokman proceeds with tax reform to weaken and divide the power of nobles, including Mishil.

44.o: Mishil finds out about Deokman's plan and tries to scuttle it by getting in touch with officials in advance.

45.o: Seohyeon and Yongchun tell Seolwon that they won't budge an inch unless they get the King's arrest approval.

46.o: Mishil orders a state of martial law and for Deokman to be captured and killed. Deokman's supporters are tortured into revealing her location.

47.o: An attack on Deokman's hideout brings tragic consequences for both sides, compelling Deokman to return to the palace.

48.o: Deokman visits Mishil at the palace and tells her that she will be interrogated in front of all the officials.

49.o: With every intent on having Silla for herself, Mishil escapes with her loyal band of soldiers and starts a civil war.

50.o: Deokman offers a peaceful alliance, testing Mishil's will to continue fighting for her dream.

51.o: Following Mishil's death, Deokman must regain the loyalties of her followers, but Bidam also has plans of his own.

52.o: Years into Deokman's reign, the Internal Affairs under Bidam begin arresting suspected traitors that are linked to Yushin.

53.o: Bidam tells Deokman about Yusin's involvement in Secret Society Bokya to make her order an investigation.

54.o: While Bidam tracks down the Bokya, Yushin is sent on a private mission to spy on the enemy kingdom of Baekje.

55.o: Yushin's information is deemed faulty and that places greater pressure on Deokman to execute him. Meanwhile Bidam tries to secure Deokman's heart.

56.o: Seolwon asks Deokman to entrust him with full powers over Silla's military if he wins the war against Baekje.

57.o: With Wolya's surrender, Yusin becomes a major general again. Bidam shows how sincere his love for Deokman is.

58.o: Deokman orders Bidam's private soldiers to join the national military, and Bidam is glad about it.

59.o: Bidam's supporters betray him in the hopes that he will break his engagement off with Deokman and claim the throne for himself.

60.o: Conspiracies surround Bidam, prompting Deokman to send Bidam far from the capital until the furor dies down.

61.o: A misunderstanding breaks the fragile trust between Deokman and Bidam, and the palace undergoes a second military coup.

62.o: Bidam lays siege upon the capital, but when he learns the truth of Deokman's betrayal, he seals his doomed fate.

1.o: After dying in another time-line, Ragna the Bloodedge seeks to continue his quest. He fights with his brother, Jin Kisaragi, and meets Noel Vermillion, who has strange memories of him.

2.o: Ragna beats Hakumen, one of the Six Heroes, and is next faced with Nu-13. Noel, the true successor to the Azure, saves his life and kills Nu.

3.o: Rachel has her showdown with Takemikazuchi, Hazama shows his true colors, and Ragna faces a fight with yet another bounty hunter.

4.o: As Ragna recovers from his wounds, Rachel meets with three mysterious beings and Noel runs into an old friend and classmate from the Military Academy.

5.o: Rachel conducts her own mysterious business as usual, porting from place to place. Kokonoe has her own agenda and sends Tager to carry out a mission. And Ragna works towards a full recovery with the help of some friends.

6.o: Kokonoe's little gambit with Ragna plays out. In the meantime, Jin is still searching for Ragna, but instead, ends up being found by Bang Shishigami, who wants revenge against Jin.

7.o: Tager continues to slowly track Noel. Noel finds Tsubaki, which results in a complicated showdown. And Rachel leads Ragna to where he needs to be and to confront what he already knows.

8.o: Hazama throws an obstacle in Ragna's way to buy himself some time. This encounter leads Ragna to have an entirely different sort of experience with Lambda.

9.o: As Makoto works to get Noel to safety, she explains her faith in Kokonoe and her doubts about Hazama. And Tsubaki finally finds Jin again, who is still struggling to deal with his recalcitrant weapon.

10.o: Noel and Makoto fight a losing battle against Hazama while Ragna fights Jin inside the Cathedral. Noel disappears, and Hazama reveals a secret to Ragna.

11.o: Hazama's interference keeps Ragna from using his powers. Noel is reborn in the Cauldron as Mu-12 and attacks her former friends.

12.o: Kokonoe and Rachel believe that Noel's transformation into Mu is irreversible, but Ragna refuses to give up on Noel.

1.o: Dong Ju, the top student in his school, falls in love with Su Wan. He helps her out, but she just ignores him.

2.o: On Su Wan's birthday, Dong Ju and Su Wan do bungee jumping together, something she always dreamed of doing.

4.o: Su Wan apologizes to Dylan for overstepping her bounds and asks if they've ever met before.

5.o: Hearing about the tension between Su Wan and Dylan, Ji Woon invites them both over for dinner.

6.o: Ji Woon is sad that Su Wan still can't forget her first love. Jae Bum keeps telling Dong Ju to leave.

7.o: Young Ji wants an engagement party for Su Wan and Ji Woon, but Su Wan tells Ji Woon that she can't love him.

8.o: Jae Bum keeps trying to separate Su Wan and Dong Ju, but Dong Ju can't give up on her and pleads with Jae Bum.

9.o: Ji Woon tells Dong Ju to return to America. Ji Woon drunkenly tells Su Wan he wants to be the one for her.

10.o: Seeing Ji Woon distraught, Young Ji asks Su Wan if she loves him. She replies she turned down his proposal.

11.o: Jae Bum recommends that Su Wan and Dong Ju move elsewhere to live freely. Jin Sang puts pressure on Jae Bum.

12.o: Ordered by Young Ji, the police chief approaches Woo Chul with an offer. Jin Sang asks to see Dong Ju.

13.o: Dong Ju tries to convince Su Wan to move to America. Su Wan is angered by his change of heart.

14.o: Dong Ju seeks Jae Bum's help in persuading Su Wan. Jae Bum finds his attitude strange and talks to Jin Sang.

15.o: Su Wan asks Jae Bum if he killed Jeong Hwa. Dong Ju finds Jae Bum conscious on the floor at Su Wan's place.

16.o: Upon learning the truth, Hae Ju finds Su Wan and begs her not to leave Dong Ju. Su Wan says it's for the best.

17.o: Jae Bum hands Dong Ju the MP3 player and dies. Ji Woon, tormented by the guilt, considers turning himself in.

18.o: Seeing Young Ji with the police chief, Ji Woon questions her. Old 911 call recordings reveal something.

19.o: Su Wan leaves a note and disappears. A year later, Ji Woon, now doing volunteer work, finds her in a photo.

20.o: Su Wan admits she can't let go of Dong Ju, but Dong Ju gets hit by a car while trying to save a girl.

1.t: A Rain of Ogres from the Sky
1.o: Yukina, a sophomore at Tateyama High, visits Kurobe Laboratory when it is suddenly attacked. While escaping, she touches a mysterious cube.

2.o: Kennosuke Tokisada Ouma appears from the cube. He tries to save Yukina but is knocked unconscious. A new large scale geoframe emerges from Toyama Bay.

3.t: The Silent Walls of a Castle Ruins
3.o: Kennosuke, with Yukina along for the ride, is victorious, but the enemy geoframe gets away. He is captured once again but escapes and finds Koharu.

4.o: After realizing the extent of his slumber, Kennosuke is invited by Yukina's uncle to live with the family. The modern world continues to confound him.

5.o: Yukina returns to school, hoping life is finally going back to normal - only to be horrified when she catches a glimpse of the new transfer student.

6.o: Ken and Yukina resume their battle with the Yellow Crab mecha. Classmates Akagi and Kayahara defy the authorities and head closer to the battle zone.

7.o: After the Yellow Crab's pilot takes his own life, Yukina loses her will to fight. At school, she learns that Akagi and Kayahara are still missing.

8.o: As the invaders' demands cause friction, Yukina leaves home to avoid battle. Kennosuke goes to search for her but realizes he knows nothing about her.

9.o: An enormous enemy geoframe appears, but with Yukina missing, the center lacks the power to oppose it. Ken, Akagi and Kayahara continue the search.

10.o: The captured pilot is taken back to the research center and questioned. He says that he came to find a certain object. Ken appears to recognize him.

11.o: The enemy pilot unexpectedly escapes and is able to restore his geoframe. Yukina is ordered to deploy in the Kuromukuro, but runs into him on the way.

12.o: Summer vacation has come, and that means more training for Ken and Yukina, who is improving more than she expected. Akagi hopes to become a pilot.

13.o: Ken's Kuromukuro fights alongside the GAUS to drive off a giant geoframe. Meanwhile, Kayahara's plan for the Culture Fair stirs up excitement.

14.o: Kennosuke has been run through by a woman with the face of his princess. Before she can finish him off, a mysterious figure leaps to his defense.

15.o: The local population begins to evacuate the area, and the school's students are transferring out. Carlos doesn't know what to say about his situation.

16.o: Sophie shows excellent results in the single-pilot GAUS, impressing Ken. Soon, he learns that her parents expect her to leave Japan.

17.o: Graham orders a comprehensive search to find the two missing enemy pilots. Meanwhile, the Efidolg mothership dispatches an additional geoframe.

18.o: Yukina and a reluctant Ken receive their salaries and decide to go to the hot springs together. Rumors of their plans spread through the school.

19.o: The Research Institute panics over Yukina's disappearance. Dr. Hausen makes a surprising discovery. Meanwhile, Sophie receives a mysterious message.

20.o: Ken is on the way, but Yukina is already planning her escape. She encounters Mirasa, who attacks. Meanwhile, Sophie learns more about the enemy.

21.o: Ken and Yukina have safely returned but have no time to celebrate after the research center learns that the enemy mothership will soon land on Earth.

22.o: The enemy blockades the research center. At home, Yukina and the others are educated about the Efidolg and Yukina's missing father, Takehito.

23.o: Ken and Yukina take Muetta to school, causing a stir among the few remaining students. Carlos announces the completion of his movie scenario.

24.o: Seeking the truth, Muetta turns against her former comrades. Realizing that the deciding battle is approaching, everyone makes their preparations.

25.o: Ken and Zell are shocked to learn of a power that can resist the enemy. Everyone at school is tired of waiting for Yukina and the others' return.

26.o: Through the fight with the Efidolg, the characters find themselves closer to their aims. Kennosuke discovers the path he must walk.

1.o: Amami Hibiki is a girl who can see ghosts and other supernatural phenomena in her surroundings. The stories follow her daily life with both her friends and the otherworldly.

2.o: Nightmares about the lecherous neighborhood stray cat have been keeping Amami up at night, so a few nearby spirits have taken to answering the morning roll-call in her stead.

3.o: Inoue's bratty little cousin Yuuki is visiting. She's trying to cater to him by cooking his favorite breakfast (fried eggs) every morning, but he complains about the awful taste every time! Amami vows to help Inoue cook the best eggs ever, but after consulting with a nearby ghost, she learns that maybe Yuuki wants something more than just better flavor?

4.o: Amami and her friends join their classmate Yamada Kenta on a trip to the coast. For some reason the beach is almost empty and the kids couldn't be happier...except for Esumi Kyouko.

5.o: It's time for the school culture festival! Under Amami's supervision and the help of a few ghosts, her class decides to make a haunted house. The whole class (except Inoue) wants the result to be nothing short of legendary!

6.o: Amami's classmates are dumbfounded when she suddenly starts acting like a total brat, until Uehara Kana snaps a picture that reveals the truth: she's been possessed by "gal ghost!"

7.o: When the gang sees a sleep-deprived Amami stumbling down the street, they worry her inability to ignore her spectral friends is putting her heath at risk. They decide to speak with her father Asahi, who digs up a special pair glasses capable of blocking Amami's sixth sense.

8.o: Amami meets the ghost of a young girl who keeps repeating a mysterious nonsense word: "Morya." No longer able to recall her life or how she died, the roll-call samurai and Amami worry she may simply fade away.

9.o: Valentine's Day is getting closer and all the boys and girls are getting restless. And when the gang finds out Amami wants to try her hand at home-made chocolate, they can't help but wonder who it's for! Tune in for a sweet, emotional Valentine's Day episode. You'll never believe who Amami's heart really belongs to!

10.t: We're Now In Our Second Year
10.o: A new school year begins, and Amami and her friends are pretty excited about having younger students around. Wanting to be a model student, Amami tries to help the new freshman class...and so do her spectral friends. The otherworldly assistance scares off the new kids and leaves Amami feeling crushed, so Inoue and the others take it upon themselves to make her more appealing.

11.o: Amami invites her friends over to her house for the Star Festival, and they're excited for the visit when they learn about her late mother's handmade decorations. According to Amami, they're packed with mysterious powers that are all but guaranteed to make wishes come true...

12.o: After her sixth sense suddenly vanishes, Amami wanders aimlessly searching for her spectral friends. Their voices, their faces, even their presence is nowhere to be found. Amami quickly falls into a deep depression over the loss of the friendships she'd formed with the ghosts over the years, and Inoue and the rest of her living friends are at a loss for how to cheer her up.

13.o: Amami heads to a theme park with all her friends, living and otherwise (and Yamada's older brother, for some reason)! According to her father, this particular theme park is the site of some fond memories for Amami, but now that she's older the memories have begun to fade...until a mysterious girl appears before her. Join the whole Re-Kan! gang as they make the most of a beautiful summer day, capped off with a sleepover at the Amami residence!

1.t: Because This is My First Time Being Thirty
1.o: It’s Ji-ho’s 30th birthday and the worst day of her life at the same time. She becomes homeless overnight as her roommate younger brother wants her pregnant girlfriend to move in. Meanwhile, Se-hee is looking for a new housemate who can follow a certain set of rules.

2.t: Because This is My First Kiss
2.o: The morning after Ji-ho kissed a total stranger, she wakes up to find out that her new housemate whom she thought was a woman is actually a man. Rather than the fact that they kissed, Ji-ho and Se-hee are sad that they can’t live under the same roof as they are opposite genders.

3.t: Because This is My First Proposal
3.o: When Ji-ho gets proposed by Se-hee, she becomes confused as she doesn’t know what his intentions are. Sang-goo reunites with Soo-ji, but Soo-ji has no recollection of what happened before.

4.t: Because This is My First Marriage
4.o: Se-hee and Ji-ho decide to get married, so naturally, Ji-ho introduces her boyfriend to her family. Se-hee must impress Ji-ho’s patriarchal father in order to get his approval. Meanwhile, Won-seok tries to make up with Ho-rang by getting her the sofa she wanted.

5.t: Because This is My First Promise
5.o: Ji-ho and Se-hee’s parents meet each other for the first time. Although Ji-ho and Se-hee agreed on not holding a wedding, Ji-ho’s mom and Se-hee’s dad think otherwise. Won-seok still can’t understand why Ho-rang got mad.
